name: MultiMedQA
description: MultiMedQA is a benchmark combining six existing medical question answering datasets spanning professional medicine, research, and consumer queries, along with a new dataset HealthSearchQA. It measures clinical knowledge and reasoning capabilities of large language models in medical question answering tasks.
reputation: MultiMedQA is a well-known medical QA benchmark introduced by Google/Med-PaLM and widely used to evaluate LLMs on medical knowledge and reasoning.
notes: Combines multiple existing datasets and a new dataset; includes human evaluation framework assessing factuality, comprehension, reasoning, harm, and bias.
